# Science on the Rim Due to your crash landing, Nanotrasen has issued you a license for highly restricted technologies.
## Experimental Tier 3 [color=#9a6ef0]Experimental[/color] tech focuses on [bold]the conditions you fight in.[/bold] Bend space and time to your will, play with reality-altering technology, and manipulate the world as you see fit.
## Arsenal Tier 3 [color=#dc373b]Arsenal[/color] tech focuses on [bold]the things you fight with.[/bold] Use cutting edge technology in the front lines and wage war with terrifyingly powerful weapons.
